segments.text: We built grand monuments and architecture so that you could pass on the knowledge in a very tangible form
Vulnerable to the elements of nature, but a grand monument it embodies
the discovery of mathematics of measurement of material it protects us from the elements the cold from sun from green
from flood this structures they were not just designed to be functional they also were designed to
embody and answer some of the deepest you know questions that we struggled with as human beings
like what's our purpose on earth why did God put us here why did it give us
intelligence if we have intelligence if we have knowledge then what are we going to do with it
the way i think about human progress about scientific progress about why we built and why
we worship our tools you know our machines in bishwa karma puja or ayod puja astra puja is because
our tools you know human tools were designed to not just solve problems
we also wanted to reach out express that desire for meaning for purpose that desire to connect with
